directions: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
The appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning is a topic that has sparked much debate among students. To begin with, AI can offer personalized learning experiences. For example, it can analyze students' learning habits and weaknesses, then provide customized study plans. This helps students make the most of their study time and improve efficiency.

In addition, AI can serve as an always-available learning companion. Students can ask questions at any time, and AI will provide instant answers. It's like having a private tutor on hand 24/7, which is especially useful for those who have difficulty accessing traditional tutoring resources.

However, we must also be cautious. If students rely too much on AI, they may lose the ability to think independently. For instance, some students might simply copy AI-generated answers instead of working through problems on their own.

In conclusion, while AI technology can be a powerful tool for learning, we should use it appropriately. We need to strike a balance between leveraging its benefits and maintaining our own thinking and learning abilities.
